method.coordinate_units: accepted geometry and body positions are metres; report geometry centroids/displacements in millimetres; wrist angles in degrees.
method.geometry: accepted MRVPACK stable rows 130/132/134; centroid is arithmetic mean of unique captured surface vertex positions; relative vector is centroid(other) - centroid(PQ), with changes relative to same-run step 0.
method.interpretation_limit: Body-pose-derived q is reconstructed from accepted body orientations, not a directly serialized generalized-coordinate trace. Surface centroid motion is descriptive whole-surface kinematics, not local contact/separation or anatomical efficacy.
method.joint_pose_formula: motion = inverse(parent_body_quaternion * parent_joint_rotation) * (child_body_quaternion * child_joint_rotation); q = 2 atan2(dot(motion.xyz, authored_axis), motion.w).
method.validation: NHRIGID2 joint type/indices/axes are pinned; all four coordinates reconstruct approximately zero at accepted step 0 and retain quaternion-vector orthogonal residual below the threshold recorded per sample.
